english.note: Use 一幕 for one distinct scene or section of a play, film, or other dramatic work.

examples.english: The most moving scene in this film is when the main character says goodbye to his mother at the station.
examples.traditional: 呢套戲最感人嘅一幕，就係主角喺車站同阿媽道別。
